scope: Printed-parameter calculations only; not a run of the repository or its stored outputs

lhs_counterexample.event: coordinates fall in same half of [0,1]
lhs_counterexample.implication: The iid share standard error need not overstate randomized-LHS error; iid order-statistic/binomial laws do not automatically apply to dependent LHS outputs.

central.finite_exact_completion: never: U>0 geometrically after capacity becomes slack

fast.finite_exact_completion: never: U>0 geometrically after capacity becomes slack

program_recurrence.note: Values from supplement S2.7/S2.9 and TableS11 pp38-39. Dates here are program time; calendar freeze law is deliberately not guessed.

price_revenue_identity.note: Example of the accounting identity only. Not a correction to S12.2's actual path, whose year-by-year prices have not been provided in the PDFs.

central_execution_exception.implication: The condition 'central execution' alone does not imply failure of a five-year cash-payback test; main pp5/64 need central-other-input or exception qualifiers.

positive_capital_counterexample.note: Static score counterexample only: no claim that 70% mature software-market growth is empirically plausible. Shows negligible capital needs are not a mathematical necessity of score>100.

negative_cash_capital_counterexample.note: Matches the negative cash capital extension acknowledged on main p60: sustained score>100 at growth below32.5%, so the central k=0 threshold is not a universal necessary condition.
